entities.name: GlmU bifunctional enzyme
observations: 454-aa query is 83% identical across 100% coverage to reviewed Acinetobacter baumannii GlmU homologs (Swiss-Prot accessions B2I2B5, B0VPT6, B0V9X1).
Homology supports bifunctional GlmU activity: acetylates glucosamine-1-phosphate and transfers UMP from UTP to form UDP-GlcNAc.
Reference annotations report Mg2+ binding, cytoplasmic localization, and homotrimeric assembly; these are inferred for the query from homologs.
Sequence-derived estimates: 48.64 kDa, pI 5.84; Pfam hits include NTP-transferase and C-terminal hexapeptide-repeat domains.
